audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0-3].side all read 'Lucian' while content win[0-3] all read 'Xayah', matching the packet's levelChart (Xayah,Xayah,Xayah,Xayah,Xayah,Lucian,Xayah). phases[4].side and phases[6].side read generic 'Skill' while win[4]/win[6] say Xayah. phases[5].side reads 'Skill' while win[5] says Lucian, and phases[5].why is written Xayah-favorable even though the correct side there is Lucian's first-item spike.
audit.why: Lucian's poke is short-range and blockable by minions early, so Xayah wins levels 1-5 per win[0..3] and whys[0..3]; he swings ahead only at his first item via Essence Reaver plus Lightslinger passive burst (win[5], whys[5], spikes[2]); Xayah retakes it 2+ items per win[6]/whys[6].

audit.why: First-item Essence Reaver spike and level 6 R-vs-R interaction (Featherstorm untargetable through The Culling) are both correctly identified in content.spikes.

audit.whatIsWrong: No field states that Lucian's Lightslinger (P) is an auto-attack-reset burst tell, that it grants him a shield-equivalent bonus-damage window off ally heals/shields, or that his sustained chip damage needs Grievous Wounds timing.
audit.why: enemyKit P flags list autoReset ('burst timing tell'), shield ('absorbs burst — changes all-in maths'), and heal ('anti-heal target — Grievous Wounds timing matters'); missingInteractions flags all three as unaddressed on this matchup's page.
audit.corrected: Folded the auto-reset tell into dosFull[1].d, the anti-heal timing into dontsFull[2].d, and the passive's bonus-damage trigger into breakdown.cooldowns.
